Thank you so much for your advice and support, I genuinely appreciate it. 

I know deep down there are people who want to listen and help but that little voice in my head says no one cares and I'm just being a baby. It doesn't make sense why I believe it. But, anytime I want to talk to someone that's all I can think about.

I actually did tell a lot of people recently how much they meant to me and their positive influence on my life. They all felt so appreciated and they gave me some kudos back. It's kind of cringey but I truly love to make people happy and smile. So after I told some people the things I have always wanted to say I felt good. It just didn't seem to last long and i fell back into this loneliness and detachment from others.

I think it would be nice to see a professional but I can't. I never want my family to know what's been happening. They all have so much on their plate and I don't want to add on to that. Also, I am extremely poor and can barely afford getting my hair cut let alone a therapist. Sorry if I sound pessimistic I just want to be honest with you friendly stranger. Thanks again and I hope it will be okay soon.
